overview_description.description:
Fogbender helps B2B companies support customer teams: think Intercom meets Slack's shared channels.

Today, all customer software is explicitly or implicitly designed for helping individuals, not teams. This is forcing B2B companies - who sell products to teams, not individuals - to augment their default customer support platform (Zendesk, Intercom, Front, etc) with a second, "unofficial", system: Slack's shared channels.

This causes a number of operational and logistical difficulties for both vendors and their customers, resulting in added costs, inefficiencies, and lost opportunities.

With Fogbender, B2B vendors embed a team-to-team messaging widget directly on their customer dashboard, where all users belonging to an account can - with no additional authentication - 1) see a list of currently-open issues 2) participate in conversations with their own team and the vendor, and 3) search all historical discussions.

product.name: Fogbender Team Messaging Widget
product.description: An embeddable messaging widget for B2B customer support that enables communication between a company’s support agents and customer teams within the product interface.

product.name: Fogbender Jira Integration
product.description: An integration that allows filing Jira tickets directly from customer conversations within Fogbender.

product.name: Fogbender Slack Integration
product.description: An integration that connects Fogbender customer rooms to Slack channels, enabling support conversations to appear as threads within Slack.

product.name: Fogbender Microsoft Teams Integration
product.description: An integration that imports users and synchronizes messages between Fogbender and Microsoft Teams for B2B support.

product.name: Fogbender End-User Management
product.description: A system for managing customer organizations and their users within the Fogbender platform, supporting multiple import methods and user attribute management.
